sloka: काले काले तु मां वीर अयोध्यामवलोकितुम् ।आगच्छ त्वं नरश्रेष्ठ गन्तासि च पुरं तव ।। ७.७२.१५ ॥
transliteration: kāle kāle tu māṁ vīra ayodhyāmavalokitum ।āgaccha tvaṁ naraśreṣṭha gantāsi ca puraṁ tava ।। 7.72.15 ॥

translations.english: O brave one, O best among men, you should come to Ayodhya from time to time to see me, and you will also return to your own city.
